# Utopia.de

> > Utopia.de is Germany's leading sustainability portal, offering guidance on eco-living, sustainable food, green lifestyle choices, and environmental responsibility since 2007.

Utopia.de provides comprehensive German-language content on sustainable living, including recipes (Rezepte), nutrition advice (Ernährung), eco-friendly products, green energy (Ökostrom), and practical tips for transitioning to a more environmentally conscious lifestyle. The platform serves as a central hub for the German-speaking sustainability community.
